name: watchbill
description: A role model for multi-agent work in herdr with a human in the loop: the Playbook Architect and the steward side by side, rules and run leads, pinned crew sub-types, a delegation layer for launching and closing delegates, an editor for collaborative drafting, two-party handoff with historians, paper-trail rules and the watcher contract. One seat changes the playbook, another runs the work, and every relief leaves a log.

human_name.title: Human's name
human_name.description: How seats name the human in the loop in messages and status lines. Default: the human.

forbidden_models.title: Forbidden models
forbidden_models.description: Models no seat may spawn or launch (for example one your plan cannot afford), per role: `fable` forbids it for every role; `architect: none` or `steward: fable haiku` is that role's own list. The role is the one being launched. The model guard denies them and spawn refuses them. Default: none.

require_explicit_model.title: Require an explicit model
require_explicit_model.description: Remind a seat when a generic Agent call names no model, so no delegate silently gets the session's default.

alert_channels.title: Alert channels
alert_channels.description: How a seat stopped on the human gets their attention, in order. Default: tab glyph only.

decision_channels.title: Decision channels
decision_channels.description: Where the human gives decisions (for example chat, Track Changes notes, boards). A system's brief names its channels from this list. Default: chat.

drafting_tool.title: Drafting tool
drafting_tool.description: The Track Changes command line tool the editor and checkers use: a command on PATH or a path to one with the same subcommands. Empty: `obsidian-track-changes-agent`, the obsidian-track-changes-agent plugin's command.

drafting_author.title: Drafting author
drafting_author.description: The author name the human's Track Changes marks carry. Empty: the human's name.

headroom_command.title: Headroom command
headroom_command.description: A command spawn runs first to check the machine has room for another session; a non-zero exit refuses the spawn. Empty: no check.

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.description: The scheduler that may restart or wake a seat, and its state. Default: none, meaning nothing restarts a seat that closes.

infra_home.title: Infrastructure home
infra_home.description: The project folder a fault outside a system's subject (a server, a config, a token store) is handed to. Empty: the fault goes to the human.

workspace_label.title: Workspace label
workspace_label.description: The herdr workspace label for a system; {SUBJECT} is replaced by the subject in capitals.

overlay_file.title: Overlay file
overlay_file.description: A private markdown file of your own rules, printed into every session's context at start. Empty: none.

relief_deadline_minutes.title: Relief deadline (minutes)
relief_deadline_minutes.description: How long either side of a two-party relief waits for the other before `relief-check` lets the receiver take over (origin gone) or marks the seat stopped on the human.

handoff_offer_tokens.title: Handoff offer band (tokens)
handoff_offer_tokens.description: Context size at which a seat offers the human a handoff, for cost. The hard line stays handoff_hard_percent.

handoff_hard_percent.title: Hard handoff line (percent)
handoff_hard_percent.description: Percent of the context window at which a seat hands off.

context_window_tokens.title: Context window (tokens)
context_window_tokens.description: The context window size the percentages are taken of.
